text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Flower-san. As a present, 
I tried baking your favorite sweets, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The moment I touched the oven, it ceased 
functioning for unknown reasons. Mission 
'Sweets Making' has failed. My sincere 
apologies...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all~ Please don't worry about 
it, Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Under these circumstances, I require an 
alternative plan. Please state any wishes 
you may have.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"A wish, you say? Um... well... In that 
case..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to roast marshmallows and 
eat them with me? I figured if we used a 
charcoal grill instead of an oven, it 
wouldn't make Bourbon-san nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order confirmed. However... despite it 
being Flower-san's birthday, is it truly 
acceptable for me to be the one treated to 
a meal?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, I'm completely fine! Because, um, 
I... love it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Watching you blow on hot food to cool it 
down, Bourbon-san... ...is really cute♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order confirmed. ――Updating database. My 
cooling operation, "Blow-blow," is cute.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Upon updating information... I have 
confirmed a 'flushed' status in my facial 
expression. ...Phew, phew.
